FINAL ANSWER: 13,047 CHIP variant calls remain after removing reference calls from the dataset.

Interpretation (self-contained): The dataset is 86 per-sample CHIP call-list workbooks (data/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/230209_Exome_GRCh38_CHIP_<ID>.xlsx) with a two-row header (loaded with header=1). Every row is a CHIP variant entry (In_CHIP=True for 100% of rows). A "reference call" is a row where Zygosity == 'Reference'. Removing reference calls is a row-level operation: drop those rows and count the rest, with NO deduplication of multi-transcript (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) rows. Rows with missing (NaN) zygosity are KEPT, because a missing call is not a reference call.

Headline count (rows/calls): 57,258 total rows across all 86 files − 44,211 Reference rows = 13,047 non-Reference rows remaining (this includes 1,151 missing-zygosity rows).

Sensitivity check (strict): counting only called non-reference zygosity (Heterozygous + Homozygous Variant, excluding the 1,151 missing rows) = 11,896.

Secondary context (unique variant positions, Chr:Pos|Ref/Alt): 707 unique CHIP variants in the union; 699 have ≥1 non-reference call (incl. missing), 673 have ≥1 het/homvar call; 8 are reference in every sample.

Trio reconciliation: Trio_Status lists 87 sample IDs but only 86 variant files exist; trio ID 533 has NO variant file and is therefore excluded by necessity. All other 86 files map to trio IDs by ID prefix (e.g., 179-P1↔179, SRR5463149↔SRR5463149).

Executed analysis: /workspace/analysis.py (run with python3 analysis.py); outputs all figures above.
